lines: Made with AI · በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት የተሰራ
Voice: Gemini TTS · Images: FLUX.2 klein · Motion: Wan 2.2 · Music: ACE-Step 1.5

shots.reason: Establishing shot: tells the viewer this is a highland village at dawn before we go inside.
shots.image_prompt: A small Ethiopian highland village of round thatched houses at dawn, mist in the valley, eucalyptus trees, one thin line of smoke rising from a chimney in the centre
shots.motion_prompt: Mist drifts slowly through the valley, the smoke rises gently, the camera pushes in very slowly.
shots.narration: ጠዋት ሲነጋ፣ መንደራችን በጭጋግ ተሸፍኖ ነበር።
shots.subtitle: At dawn, our village lay wrapped in mist.

shots.reason: Introduces the grandmother through what she does, not what she looks like.
shots.image_prompt: The grandmother sits on a low stool roasting green coffee beans in a flat iron pan over a small charcoal stove, inside her home
shots.motion_prompt: She slowly stirs the beans with a small stick, thin smoke curls upward, the camera stays still.
shots.narration: አያቴ ሁልጊዜ ቡናውን በራሷ እጅ ትቆላ ነበር።
shots.subtitle: My grandmother always roasted the coffee with her own hands.

shots.reason: A sensory close-up: the smell is the memory, so we stay on the beans and smoke.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of dark roasted coffee beans glistening in a flat iron pan, fragrant smoke rising, glowing charcoal below
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke rises and swirls softly above the beans, the camera pushes in gently.
shots.narration: የተቆላው ቡና ሽታ ቤቱን ሁሉ ይሞላው ነበር።
shots.subtitle: The smell of roasted coffee filled the whole house.

shots.reason: Insert of the pounding hands; the rhythm becomes the film's heartbeat motif.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the grandmother's weathered hands pounding roasted coffee in a wooden mortar (mukecha) with a metal pestle
shots.motion_prompt: Her hands lift and lower the pestle in a slow steady rhythm, the camera stays still.
shots.narration: በሙቀጫው ስትወቅጠው፣ ድምፁ እንደ ልብ ምት ነበር።
shots.subtitle: When she pounded it in the mortar, it sounded like a heartbeat.

shots.reason: The pour is the moment of attention; a tight shot makes the viewer hold their breath too.
shots.image_prompt: The grandmother lifts a black clay jebena and pours a thin stream of coffee into small white handleless cups (sini) on a wooden tray
shots.motion_prompt: A slow thin stream of coffee pours into the cup, steam rises, the camera stays still.
shots.narration: ጀበናውን ስታነሳ፣ ሁላችንም ዝም እንል ነበር።
shots.subtitle: When she lifted the jebena, we all fell silent.

shots.reason: Wide shot of the gathering carries the theme: coffee is the reason, togetherness is the point.
shots.image_prompt: A family of several generations sitting on low stools in a circle around the grandmother and her coffee tray, frankincense smoke, morning light from a window
shots.motion_prompt: Incense smoke drifts across the room, the camera pans slowly to the right.
shots.narration: «ቡና ሰበብ ነው፤ ዋናው መገናኘት ነው» ትል ነበር።
shots.subtitle: "Coffee is just the excuse," she used to say. "What matters is being together."

shots.reason: Her face, finally close, as the three rounds name the ritual's patience.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up portrait of the grandmother smiling softly, steam from a coffee cup in the foreground, warm window light on her face
shots.motion_prompt: She blinks and her smile deepens slightly, steam drifts upward, the camera pushes in very slowly.
shots.narration: አቦል፣ ቶና፣ በረካ፤ ሦስቱ ዙር ሳያልቅ ማንም አይነሳም ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Abol, tona, bereka: nobody rose before all three rounds were poured.

shots.reason: Closing image: the empty stool and the jebena turn the memory into absence and love.
shots.image_prompt: An empty low wooden stool beside a clay jebena on a woven grass mat, late afternoon light, a single coffee cup still on the tray
shots.motion_prompt: Dust floats in the light, the camera pulls back slowly.
shots.narration: ዛሬም ጀበና ባየሁ ቁጥር፣ ድምጿን እሰማለሁ።
shots.subtitle: Even now, whenever I see a jebena, I hear her voice.
